title: Known-Voice Cloning and the Limits of Personality Transfer for Character Design
abstract: arXiv:2610.18669v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent advances in zero-shot voice cloning systems make it possible to reproduce a recognizable voice from a short recording and attach it to arbitrary virtual characters. Prior work suggests that familiar vocal identity can carry over associated personality impressions to new targets such as robots or virtual characters. However, these works have mainly examined familiarity and personalization effects rather than directly testing whether a cloned familiar voice systematically transfers personality impressions to an embodied virtual character. Such transference raises the concern that cloned voices could be used to manipulate people into engaging with virtual characters as capable social actors. Across two studies, we investigated whether personality impressions transfer when a virtual character speaks with the cloned voice of a familiar person. translated_title: 熟知声音克隆与角色设计中人格迁移的局限性
translated_abstract: 零样本声音克隆系统的最新进展使得从短录音中重现可识别的声音并将其赋予任意虚拟角色成为可能。先前的研究表明，熟悉的声音身份可以将相关的人格印象传递到新的对象上，例如机器人或虚拟角色。然而，这些工作主要考察了熟悉度和个性化效应，而非直接测试克隆的熟悉声音是否会系统性地将人格印象迁移到具身化的虚拟角色上。这种迁移引发了一种担忧：克隆声音可能被用来操纵人们，使其将虚拟角色视为有能力的社交主体并与之互动。通过两项研究，我们考察了当虚拟角色以熟悉之人的克隆声音说话时，人格印象是否会发生迁移。研究1在真实的大学环境中使用……的克隆声音检验了这一问题。
tldr: 该论文通过两项研究考察了虚拟角色使用熟悉者的克隆声音时人格印象能否迁移，揭示了声音克隆在角色设计中的迁移局限及其可能被滥用于操纵用户的风险。
en_tdlr: Through two studies, this paper examines whether personality impressions transfer to virtual characters speaking with a cloned familiar voice, revealing the limits of personality transfer in character design and the potential manipulation risks of voice cloning.
